population: CHNS 2009 released-data analytical population: adults aged 35-74 years inclusive, linked person/wave records with documented male/female category and available age, BMI from released height/weight, central-serum glucose and whole-blood HbA1c under the frozen common-complete-case release policy. No diabetes, treatment or pregnancy exclusion is claimed. Age/sex composition is not supplied. This is a selected analytical sample, not a nationally representative population; no participant input.

measurement.description: Arithmetic in supplied task units only. Source fasting plasma glucose versus target central-serum glucose and fasting comparability are explicit unverified transfer assumptions, no conversion or assay calibration implemented.

Reported unadjusted Pearson association in full eligible Singapore sample; all-row task comparison assumes population and measurement transport. Used as model correlation constraint. Source flow inconsistency: 5157 examinations minus stated exclusions 325, 932 and 2 equals 3898, whereas reported analytic N and ethnic counts total 3895. Retain reported N=3895; unexplained difference of three, no invented exclusion and no model parameter depends on its resolution.
